user.title: Shutter Times
user.description:
Creates an instance (as many as you like, e.g. per façade). Sun position, offset and earliest/latest limits are set afterwards as entities of the device.

[Documentation (README)]({docs_url})

data_description.weekend_days: On these weekdays the “Earliest time up WE/DO” applies (WE = weekend, DO = days off).
data_description.free_calendars: Optional. If any of these calendars has an event today (holiday, vacation, shift …), the weekend/days-off time applies as well. Any number of calendars.
data_description.device_type: Shutter/blind or awning: only changes the names of the time limits (“Earliest time up” vs. “Earliest time automation”, “… down” vs. “… retract”).
